messages:
maria: Quick sync — need to lock owners + ETAs for postmortem action items from yesterday's P1. I'm listing items below; please ack and update if you need different dates. @devon @sam @jade @oncall-bot

devon: ack. I'll take the NGINX probe fix. ETA Fri 03/27 EOD. Will need a small config test window.

sam: ack. I'll pick up the KV cache guardrail but blocked on infra kernel bump. @eng-infra any timeline?

jade: I can do the logs backfill, but need DB export access. @maria can you trigger access?

oncall-bot: Incident #2026-0412 summary: P1 degraded model-serving in us-west for ~22m. Actions created: 4; owners: devon, sam, jade, maria. See incident runbook link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2026-0412

maria: Thanks. Here's the action list — edit if wrong:

```
1) NGINX probe flapping -> owner: devon -> due: 2026-03-27
2) KV cache guardrail + rate limit -> owner: sam -> due: 2026-03-30 (blocked by infra)
3) Backfill missing rollback logs -> owner: jade -> due: 2026-03-29 (needs DB access)
4) Postmortem writeup + timeline -> owner: maria -> due: 2026-03-26
```

devon: noted. I'll reserve a 30m test slot tomorrow 10:30-11:00 PT. If tests pass, I'll push the probe fix and ping @eng-sre for verification.

sam: infra update — kernel bump is scheduled 2026-03-25 AM; if that lands on schedule I can finish guardrail by 03/30. If it slips, can we extend to 04/02?

maria: Let's keep 03/30 but call out blockers. sam — please update the action with "blocked: infra kernel bump" and set tentative fallback ETA 04/02.

jade: @maria access request filed (IAM#7891). pinging infra to expedite. If approved today I can start tomorrow.

devon: small doc note — add a post-deploy smoke check step to the runbook so probes don't get misdetected. I'll add a PR to infra-runbooks.

maria: Good. I'll take the postmortem draft. If everyone can add short notes to the doc by EOD Thu I'll assemble and publish on Friday. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up check-in in 48h for outstanding actions.

sam: ack — will update the action ticket with blocker and fallback ETA.

jade: ack — will start after access.

devon: ack — test slot booked, will update ticket with results.

maria: thanks all. I'll follow up in 48h and assign any follow-ons. /end
